description: AICTIONBOT™ offer against contract by KULIC Advisory (tool 57). Takes the text of an offer (or the last negotiated version) and the text of the contract that is about to be signed, and optionally a list of agreed points, one per line. Compares the figures, deadlines and dates per topic (price, payment and discount, term and termination, liability, penalty, warranty, non-solicitation, confidentiality, jurisdiction, travel expenses): match, different, in the offer but missing in the contract, only in the contract. Each agreed point is checked against the contract. Ends with a ready message to the other side and the next step. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Not legal advice. To compare two versions of the same contract use compare_contracts. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

agreed.description: Optional: points agreed in the negotiation, one per line, for example 'Payment terms 30 days net'.

contract_text.description: Full text of the contract to be signed.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

offer_text.description: Full text of the offer or of the last negotiated version.

name: compare_offer_to_contract
title: Offer against contract: is what was negotiated really in the contract? Figures and deadlines per topic side by side, agreed points ticked off, message to the other side
